_what: The Faery Yurt's art gallery: paintings Helen picked, each out of copyright everywhere and scanned by a museum or a gallery, hung small on her wall and opened into a gilt frame. Read by tools/make-yurt-gallery.py, which refuses a painter dead seventy years or less, a scan whose Commons page carries no public domain template, a file not on disk or still carrying EXIF, and a picture with no sentence saying what it shows.
_how: Painter, title and year were read off each file's own record on Wikimedia Commons (the Artist, ObjectName and DateTimeOriginal fields) on the day above, never from memory; the one date Commons leaves blank, Hope's, is the Walker Art Gallery's own dating, read off its page. The file is Commons' own copy, resized to 1400 pixels across at most and re-saved with its colour profile and no other metadata. The `shows` sentences are ours, written from looking at each picture, and are the alt text.

paintings.title: La Belle Dame sans Merci
paintings.shows: A woman in a pink gown and a crown of flowers leans down from a dark horse towards a knight in plate armour, who looks up at her with his helmet in one hand and his other arm flung out, on a hillside of wild roses at dusk.

paintings.title: Ophelia
paintings.shows: A young woman with long red hair and a white dress sits on the trunk of a willow at the edge of a pond covered in lily pads, both hands raised to a red flower in her hair, with daisies in her lap and wild roses at her feet.

paintings.title: Windflowers
paintings.shows: A young woman in a white dress with mauve sleeves walks through a meadow of anemones, one hand holding back her dark hair as the wind pulls at it and at her skirt, a bunch of purple flowers gathered in the other.

paintings.title: Dante's Dream at the Time of the Death of Beatrice
paintings.shows: In a dim room strewn with red poppies, a figure in red bends to kiss a woman lying in white, while two women in green hold a canopy over her and a man in a dark hood is led in from the left by the hand.

paintings.title: Hope
paintings.shows: A blindfolded figure in pale draperies sits hunched on top of a globe, head bowed close to a lyre with every string but one broken, against a cloudy blue haze.

paintings.title: Midsummer Eve
paintings.shows: A young woman in a gold dress and a wreath of leaves stoops forward in a dark wood, hands clasped at her knees, looking down at a crowd of tiny winged figures who carry glowing lanterns through the grass round her bare feet.

paintings.title: The Lady of Shalott
paintings.shows: A woman with long red hair and a white dress sits in a small boat among reeds on a dark river, one hand on its mooring chain, a tapestry trailing over the side and three candles at the prow, with trees and a far hillside behind.

paintings.title: Ophelia
paintings.shows: A young woman floats on her back in a stream, her hands open at the surface, her embroidered dress spreading in the water among scattered flowers, under a bank thick with willow, nettles and wild roses.

paintings.title: Jane Morris (The Blue Silk Dress)
paintings.shows: A dark-haired woman in a blue silk dress rests her chin on her folded hands at a table, looking away to the left, with white roses in a glass vase and an open book beside her against a red curtain.

paintings.title: The Beguiling of Merlin
paintings.shows: A woman in a flowing blue-grey gown, a dark cloth wound in her hair, reads aloud from an open book as she steps through flowering hawthorn, looking back at an old man in dark green robes who lies limp and spellbound in the branches beside her, with white irises at her bare feet.

paintings.title: The Magic Circle
paintings.shows: A barefoot woman in a pale blue dress and a red sash draws a circle in the dusty ground with a long wand, a crescent sickle in her other hand, beside a cauldron steaming over a fire, with ravens and a skull waiting outside the circle and pale cliffs behind.

paintings.title: Hylas and the Nymphs
paintings.shows: A young man in a blue tunic and a red sash leans down at the edge of a dark pond with a jug, and seven pale nymphs with long red-brown hair rise bare-shouldered from the water among the lily pads, one taking hold of his arm.

paintings.title: Night with her Train of Stars
paintings.shows: Night, a crowned woman with great dark wings and a finger to her lips, sweeps across a cloudy blue sky holding a sleeping baby, trailing a crowd of small children among scattered stars, red flowers and a flight of little golden birds.

paintings.title: Black Square
paintings.shows: A black square painted on a white ground, the black paint cracked all over into a web of fine pale lines.

paintings.title: Suprematist Composition: White on White
paintings.holder: The Museum of Modern Art, New York
paintings.shows: A tilted square in a cool off-white, painted on a slightly warmer off-white ground, so the one shape is only just there.

shelf._what: Artists whose work is still their own, so nothing of theirs hangs here: each is a spine on the Art shelf in the bookcases, linking to Wikipedia. Checked to answer 200 without a redirect on 2026-10-15. Agnes Martin, Hiroshi Sugimoto and James Turrell joined on 2026-10-21, checked the same way that day.
